title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Earache
intro: Herbal creams for Earache are topical preparations made from various natural herbs and plants, designed to provide relief from ear pain and inflammation associated with earaches. These creams work by reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting healing, making them a popular alternative to traditional medications. Some examples of herbal creams used to treat earache include tea tree oil, which has antibacterial properties, calendula cream, which soothes and calms the skin, and aloe vera gel, which reduces inflammation and promotes healing. Additionally, other herbal creams like eucalyptus oil, chamomile oil, and lavender oil are also used to treat earache due to their analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, making them an effective and natural solution for earache relief.

intro_study: According to "Evidence-based complementary and alternative medicine : eCAM", creams for earache using the stem bark extracts of _P. thonningii_ have been found to possess significant anti-inflammatory and analgesic activities in Swiss albino mice, with the aqueous extract exhibiting higher inhibitions of xylene-induced ear oedema compared to the methanolic extract.
